pairs: For behold, the sovereign Lord of hosts will take away,
auferet a Jerusalem et a Juda validum et fortem,
from Jerusalem and from Judah, the powerful and the strong:
and all the strength from water;
the leader over fifty and the honorable in appearance;
and the skillful in mystical speech.
And I will provide children as their leaders,
and the effeminate will rule over them.
and each one against his neighbor.
The child shall rebel against the elder,
and the ignoble against the noble.
For a man will apprehend his brother,
domesticum patris sui: Vestimentum tibi est,
from the household of his own father, saying:
“The vestment is yours. Be our leader,
ruina autem hæc sub manu tua.
but let this ruin be under your hand.”
et in domo mea non est panis neque vestimentum:
and there is no bread or vestment in my house.
Do not choose to appoint me as a leader of the people.”
quia lingua eorum et adinventiones eorum contra Dominum,
because their words and their plans are against the Lord,
in order to provoke the eyes of his majesty.
The acknowledgement of their countenance is their response.
et peccatum suum quasi Sodoma prædicaverunt,
For they have proclaimed their own sin, like Sodom;
and they have not concealed it.
For evils are being repaid to them.
Tell the just man that it is well,
for he shall eat from the fruit from his own plans.
Woe to the impious man immersed in evil!
retributio enim manuum ejus fiet ei.
For retribution will be given to him from his own hands.
and women have ruled over them.
the same are deceiving you and disrupting the path of your steps.
and he stands to judge the people.
Dominus ad judicium veniet cum senibus populi sui,
The Lord will enter into judgment with the elders of his people,
For you have been devouring the vineyard,
et rapina pauperis in domo vestra.
and the plunder from the poor is in your house.
Why do you wear down my people,
and grind up the faces of the poor,
says the Lord, the God of hosts?
Pro eo quod elevatæ sunt filiæ Sion,
Because the daughters of Zion have been lifted up,
and have walked with extended necks
and advancing with a pretentious stride,
the Lord will make the heads of the daughters of Zion bald,
and the Lord will strip them of the locks of their hair.
In die illa auferet Dominus ornamentum calceamentum,
In that day, the Lord will take away their decorative shoes,
and the ornaments for their hair,
and the jewels hanging on their foreheads,
and the continual changes in appearance,
Et erit pro suavi odore fœtor,
And in place of a sweet fragrance, there will be stench.
And in place of a belt, there will be a rope.
And in place of stylish hair, there will be baldness.
And in place of a blouse, there will be haircloth.
Pulcherrimi quoque viri tui gladio cadent,
Likewise, your most handsome men will fall by the sword,
and your strong men will fall in battle.
And her gates will grieve and mourn.
And she will sit on the ground,
